### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- space kind — it is necessary that each space kind carries exactly one dimension (HCP L4 — positionVector, displacement, distance, area: ISO 80000-3 space kinds)
- space reading — it is necessary that each space reading is read at exactly one space kind (HCP L4 — ForPhysLib.Kinded.Space: PhysLib Space values read at their kinds)
- position reading (also: positionQ) — it is necessary that each position reading is read at exactly one space kind (def positionQ — a point read as a position vector)
- displacement reading (also: displacementQ) — it is necessary that each displacement reading is read at exactly one space kind (def displacementQ — two points read as a displacement)
- distance reading (also: distanceQ) — it is necessary that each distance reading is read at exactly one space kind (def distanceQ — two points read as a distance)
- length reading (also: lengthOf) — it is necessary that each length reading is read at exactly one space kind (def lengthOf — the length of a displacement)
- frame vector (also: KVector) — it is necessary that each frame vector states exactly one kind of property (HCP L4 — KVector: a frame vector with its physical kind stated)
- frame conversion (also: transport) — it is necessary that each frame conversion is typed for exactly one kind of property (HCP L4 — each conversion typed for one kind of vector)
- geometric transport (also: kGeometricTransport) — it is necessary that each geometric transport is typed for exactly one kind of property (def kGeometricTransport — the geometric transport law, naming the kind of vector it is the law for)
- boost transport (also: kBoostTransport) — it is necessary that each boost transport is typed for exactly one kind of property (def kBoostTransport — the boost law, only for velocities; the boost itself arrives kinded)
- position vector (also: positionVector) — the quantity kind `position vector` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- distance — the quantity kind `distance` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- area — the quantity kind `area` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- velocity (also: velocityK) — the quantity kind `velocity` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- force (also: forceK) — the quantity kind `force` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- duration (also: durationK) — the quantity kind `duration` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- DifferenceKind — another name for *difference law*, carried from L1
- *space reading* is read at *space kind* — verb
- *frame vector* states *kind of property* — verb
- *frame conversion* is typed for *kind of property* — verb
